Name: Pierre is Morshu
Author: falconfreeway
Description:
Pierre is now Morshu from Link: The Faces of Evil (also known as Zelda CDI). Or rather, he has been replaced and most of town is pretending everything is normal.

Includes custom sprites and dialogue. Nothing too crazy. I'm sure there's some things I missed, so I'll probably be updating it at least a few times.

Probably the dumbest thing I've put effort into, and it's my pride and joy. This is just a silly mod I made to learn a bit about how modding works and was requested by a friend of mine. This is my first mod, so if there's anything I missed, or ways I could improve it, I'd love feedback! 

Also a major shoutout to u/korrin- on the SMAPI Subreddit, they were a massive help to me while I was trying to troubleshoot.
